sourceAccuracy.note: How precise each source is, as its provider states it, and the accuracy classes counted in our snapshot (2026-11-03, #204). The user, 2026-11-03: "register that data as a fact and the same for vertical accuracy (of each data source ideally) so we can work with it for tuning up the track laying algorithm". The DTM records carry their class (TridaPresnostiPoloha, TridaPresnostiVyska); `classes` is the decree's table: mean coordinate error mxy and mean height error mH in metres. Class 9: worse than class 5 or unknown. New DTM data is kept at least in class 3 (§ 3 odst. 7).
